start.title: [TODO:it] A Prophet at the Door
start.text:
[TODO:it] Jeremiah stands before your throne.
He says Babylon is the Lord's rod.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You silence the voice, not the truth.
[TODO:it] Hard words can save a kingdom.
[TODO:it] Pride closes the only open door.

imprison_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Chains Cannot Bind Truth
imprison_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The cistern is deep, but his words remain.
The Lord still speaks through him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You call for him in secret.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Silence Is Not Safety
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The throne grows colder when prophets are sent away.
His warning still rings in your ears.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You bring him back to speak.

preach.title: [TODO:it] The Streets of Jerusalem
preach.text:
[TODO:it] Jeremiah cries out in the square.
"Turn back, or this city will fall."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Soften his message for the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] A watered prophecy saves no one.
[TODO:it] Hiding the warning hides the way out.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You let the truth be heard.

soften_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Half a Word
soften_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A muffled prophecy is no prophecy.
The Lord asked for the whole truth.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You step back and let him preach.

retreat_consequence.title: [TODO:it] The Square Is Quiet
retreat_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Without his voice, the city hears nothing.
Only its own pride.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Let him speak the full word
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You return him to the steps.

reject.title: [TODO:it] Folded Arms, Closed Hearts
reject.text:
[TODO:it] The citizens mock the prophet.
"Peace, peace," they cry.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The Lord did not send you to curse.
[TODO:it] You refuse to join the laughter.
[TODO:it] Mocking the prophet mocks the Lord.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Yours to Judge
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Anger is not the answer the Lord asks of you.
Only faithful witness.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You quiet your tongue.

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Turn from the Crowd
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Their laughter will not save the walls.
Only the word will.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You leave the mocking circle.

siege.title: [TODO:it] Babylon at the Gates
siege.text:
[TODO:it] Nebuchadnezzar's army surrounds the walls.
The prophet says: do not resist.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Trust the idols on the high places
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Wood and stone cannot lift a siege.
[TODO:it] Egypt is a broken reed.
[TODO:it] Submission to God outweighs strength.

idols_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Silent Stones
idols_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The idols cannot answer the rams at the gate.
The Lord alone speaks.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You turn from the high places.

egypt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] A Broken Reed
egypt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Egypt's army falters and turns home.
Only the Lord's word remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You set down the false hope.

famine.title: [TODO:it] Bread Is Gone
famine.text:
[TODO:it] Inside the walls, the children grow thin.
Jeremiah weeps in the empty streets.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Blame the prophet for the hunger
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Blame will not feed your people.
[TODO:it] You cannot outrun the Lord's word.
[TODO:it] Late repentance is still repentance.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Only Spoke
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The prophet did not bring the army.
Your ears refused his words.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You bow your head at last.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:it] No Hidden Path
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Every road is watched, every gate is closed.
Only the Lord can be sought now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You turn from the back gate.

fall.title: [TODO:it] The Walls Are Breached
fall.text:
[TODO:it] Fire climbs the temple stones.
Smoke covers the holy hill.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The walls cannot shelter you now.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Try to escape the broken wall
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The plain of Jericho will catch you.
[TODO:it] You bow beneath the rod He warned of.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stones Will Fall
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The temple will not be a fortress.
Its hour has come.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You step into the open.

escape_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Caught at Jericho
escape_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The Babylonians ride faster than your fear.
There is nowhere left to run.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You let the chariots take you.

exile.title: [TODO:it] The Long Road East
exile.text:
[TODO:it] Jerusalem falls behind in smoke.
The people walk the road to Babylon.
